run.notes: Durations per scenario are recorded; the run-level duration is not given because work was interleaved with user waits and reruns.

scenarios.title: The owner sees every view control on the Leads list
scenarios.observed: Leads as Owner: List/Kanban/Split view switchers present; picker ('Custom views' in dropdown mode) with Search views and footer New custom view, Manage custom views, Show custom views as tabs. Switched to tabs: tab list 'Custom views' with test, All Leads, Recently Created/Modified Leads, Today's Leads, My Leads; overflow 'More custom views' with the same footer.

scenarios.title: A user without Manage Shared Views can save a private view but cannot share it
scenarios.observed: As test user 2 (profile 'test', no metadata.views.manage): New custom view 'QA CV private' - Share with offers only 'Only me' with 'You need the Manage Shared Views permission to share a view with other people.'; Save -> 201, stored visibility private; picker shows it under CREATED BY ME. Note: Everyone / Selected users are hidden rather than shown disabled. Deleted afterwards.

scenarios.title: The API refuses a public view from a user without Manage Shared Views
scenarios.observed: As test user 2 (no metadata.views.manage): POST views {kind:list, name:QA CV api-public, visibility:everyone} -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; with a complete body -> 403; not in the user's list nor the Owner's list. (Yesterday's Fail used test user 1, whose User profile includes metadata.views.manage, so that result did not test this case.)

scenarios.title: A user a view is shared with cannot edit or delete it in the UI or the API
scenarios.observed: Owner shared 'QA CV shared' with test user 2 only. As test user 2: GET -> can_edit=false, can_delete=false; /edit shows 'You cannot edit this view - Only its owner, or someone who can manage shared views, can change it.' with no Save; PATCH name -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; DELETE -> 403. Owner re-reads: name 'QA CV shared', row_version 1 (unchanged). (Yesterday's Fail used test user 1, who has metadata.views.manage.)

scenarios.title: A user cannot open another user's private view by its ID
scenarios.observed: As test user 2: GET Owner's private view by ID -> 404 NOT_FOUND, no name or criteria in the body; /edit shows 'View not found - This view was deleted, or it is not shared with you.'; /modules/{Leads}?view={id} shows no part of the view (picker shows 'Choose a view').

scenarios.title: A view shared with selected users is hidden from everyone else
scenarios.observed: 'QA CV selected' shared with test user 2 only. Outsider test user 1 (no Manager-profile account exists; test user 1 is not in the share list): picker search -> 'No views match.', list API does not contain it, GET by ID -> 404 NOT_FOUND with no name. Test user 2 sees it under SHARED WITH ME.

scenarios.title: A non-admin's column change on a standard view stays personal
scenarios.observed: As test user 2 on All Leads: Manage columns -> Apply shows 'You changed the columns for this view. Only you see this change.'; no 'Save to view' offered; the user's list-preferences hold a personal viewColumns entry for All Leads; the view itself is unchanged (row_version 3 before and after, 7 columns; Owner sees the same). Note: Company was not in test user 2's column panel (7 visible columns only), so the change applied was the column set itself.

scenarios.title: A user without record edit rights cannot move Kanban cards
scenarios.observed: Needs a user whose profile lacks metadata.records.manage. Both available lower-profile accounts have it (test user 1 'User': metadata.records.manage true; test user 2 'test': true), so the precondition cannot be met.

scenarios.title: A user of another tenant cannot read an NDC-Staging view
scenarios.observed: Needs a signed-in user of another tenant. The case points to Test Data/AnywareStagingTempAccounts.txt; that credentials file was not used without the tester's go-ahead (credentials are only used from paths the tester gives).

scenarios.title: View requests without a valid token are refused with no data
scenarios.observed: Run as test user 2 with no other sign-in of that user during the wait. Request 1 without Authorization -> 401 TOKEN_MISSING 'Authorization token is required.', no view data. Token issued 08:57:23Z, exp 09:02:23Z (5 min): at 09:01:54 (before expiry) -> 200 with views; at 09:03:42 (80 s after expiry, >6 min after issue) -> 401, no view data. Note: the code is SESSION_REVOKED ('This session has been revoked.') rather than an expiry-specific code. (Two earlier attempts were invalid: one was revoked by a server-wide revocation around 08:30, the other by this run's own sign-in of the same user.)

scenarios.title: A request without x-tenant-id never returns another tenant's data
scenarios.observed: GET views?kind=list with bearer + x-tenant-id: 200, 7 views. Without x-tenant-id: 200, identical 7 views. With another tenant id (…0003) or a non-UUID value: 200, the same NDC-Staging views. Recorded behaviour: the header is ignored and the tenant comes from the session; no request returned another tenant's data.

scenarios.title: The editor of a system view locks its name and criteria
scenarios.observed: /views/{All Leads}/edit: name shown as locked text 'All Leads' with 'System-defined views keep their name and criteria. You can change their columns, sort and page size.'; no name input and no criteria section (cannot be changed); columns (Add field), Sort by, Direction and Records per page enabled; Save enabled. Note: the criteria section is hidden rather than shown read-only.

scenarios.title: A workspace with custom views turned off shows a clear message
scenarios.observed: Still no way to turn custom views off in CRM: this build loads the same featureFlags-Bty4zi8j.js, whose four flags are all hard-coded to return true. No workspace with custom views turned off exists, so the message cannot be reached.

scenarios.title: Picker search filters across groups, ignores case and handles Arabic
scenarios.observed: Picker search: 'Search' -> QA CV Search Alpha and QA CV Search Public; 'qa cv search alpha' -> QA CV Search Alpha; 'عملاء' -> QA CV عملاء; 'zzqq-no-match' -> 'No views match.'; cleared -> all 18 entries back.

scenarios.title: Views ticked to show as tabs stay as tabs after reload
scenarios.observed: Ticked QA CV tab1 and tab2, unticked Today's Leads. Tab bar before and after reload: test, All Leads, Recently Created Leads, Recently Modified Leads, My Leads, QA CV tab1, QA CV tab2; openListViewIds holds exactly these 7 IDs and all resolve (no deleted IDs - yesterday's stale-ID failure is not reproduced). Observation: My Leads (8f163184) is in both openListViewIds and recentlyClosedListViewIds.

scenarios.title: A pinned view cannot be unticked from the tabs
scenarios.observed: Tab menu on QA CV pinned: Edit, Pin view, Clone, Close view, Delete view. After Pin view, both 'Show as tab: QA CV pinned' checkboxes are disabled and ticked with the title 'Pinned views always show as tabs. Unpin the view to hide its tab.'; a forced click leaves it ticked; the tab stays. Observation: the message is only a native title (no aria-describedby, not shown as text).

scenarios.title: Closed views move to Recently closed, keeping at most 10
scenarios.observed: 11 'QA CV close' views shown as tabs. Close view on close01 -> Recently closed: QA CV close01, Today's Leads*, My Leads*. After closing close02…close11 -> Recently closed shows exactly 10: close11 … close02 (close01 dropped); recentlyClosedListViewIds holds the same 10 in the same order; no close tabs left.

scenarios.title: Switching between dropdown and tabs layout works and persists
scenarios.observed: 'Show custom views as a dropdown' -> after reload a 'Custom views' dropdown, no tab list (pref listPickerMode=dropdown); 'Show custom views as tabs' -> after reload the tab list with 8 tabs (pref=tabs).

scenarios.title: Every module has the five standard views and each behaves as named
scenarios.observed: Leads, Deals, Contacts, Tasks and Subscriptions each have 5 system views (keys all, my, recently_created, recently_modified, today). All returns everything (Leads 10730); My only the viewer's (owner criterion $me; Deals/Tasks pages all owner; Leads Standard layout 49/49 owner); Recently Created sorted by created_at desc, Recently Modified by updated_at desc; Today's only records created today in Cairo time (Leads 21/21). Note: on the Leads 'New Layout' layout the Owner field is not on the layout, so the API omits it from those records.

scenarios.title: The My view shows only records owned by the viewer
scenarios.observed: QA CV L01 owned by OWNER, QA CV L02 owned by test user 2 (USER). OWNER's My Leads (Standard layout): 49 rows, all owned by OWNER, includes L01, not L02. Test user 2's My Leads: 3 rows, all owned by test user 2, QA CV rows = L02 only.

scenarios.title: Today's view uses the tenant timezone (Cairo), not UTC
scenarios.observed: Needs leads created at 23:50 Cairo on D-1 and 00:10 Cairo on D; created_at cannot be backdated, and no existing lead falls in either window (Today's Leads: 21 records, oldest created 06:22 UTC today). Supporting check: Today's views in 5 modules return only records created today in Cairo time (B07). To settle it, create the two leads around 21:00 UTC (midnight Cairo).

scenarios.title: A standard view offers only Edit, Pin/Unpin, Clone, Delete View
scenarios.observed: All Leads 'Actions' menu: Edit columns, Pin view, Clone (disabled, title 'You cannot clone a system-defined view.'), Close view. No Delete view and no rename. Note: the expected list's 'Delete View' conflicts with its own 'Delete view ... not offered'; Delete is not offered.

scenarios.title: View, sort and page survive opening a record and going back
scenarios.observed: QA CV x (101 records, 10 per page). Sort dialog: Created At + Descending -> Apply ('Sort: created_at desc'); Next page -> page 2. Opened the 3rd record, browser Back -> QA CV x, Sort: created_at desc, page 2, same first row. Opened it again, in-app Back -> same view, sort and page 2. Note: the sort label shows the API names (see F06).

scenarios.title: The last selected view is restored after signing out and in
scenarios.observed: Selected QA CV x; list-preferences lastListViewId = QA CV x (fd6535d1). Profile drawer -> Logout; signed in again; Leads opens with QA CV x selected.

scenarios.title: Changing the view in Leads does not change Deals
scenarios.observed: Leads: selected QA CV x -> Deals shows All Deals -> Leads still QA CV x -> Deals still All Deals. list-preferences: Leads lastListViewId = QA CV x, Deals lastListViewId = All Deals (9707b09e).

scenarios.title: The ?view= URL opens permitted views and falls back safely for others
scenarios.observed: ?view= own QA CV x -> opens; QA CV shared-to-me (shared by test user 1) -> opens; deleted QA CV gone and test user 1's private QA CV user-private -> toast 'That view is no longer available. Showing your default view.', ?view= removed, nothing of the foreign view shown, no console errors. FAIL: the fallback is not All Leads - both land on the last-used view (QA CV close11).

scenarios.title: Preferences changed in two browser tabs are saved consistently
scenarios.observed: QA CV A and QA CV B shown as tabs. Tab 1 selected A, tab 2 selected B. Tab 1 closed B (its tab bar: A). Tab 2 (stale) closed A (its tab bar: B). Final list-preferences (version 193): openListViewIds has B and not A; recentlyClosedListViewIds starts with A and does not contain B; after reloading tab 1 the B tab is back. Lost update: tab 2's write replaced the whole preference object and undid tab 1's close; no conflict was raised.

scenarios.title: A view with a name and no criteria returns every accessible record
scenarios.observed: New custom view 'QA CV no-criteria' with no criteria -> 201, category created_by_me; returns 101 records on the Standard layout, the same as All Leads (101).

scenarios.title: The view name is validated and every accepted name is shown as plain text
scenarios.observed: D1 '' and D2 ' ': Save is disabled and 'Enter a name for the view.' is never shown. D5 (121 chars): the input stops at 120 characters, so 'A view name can be at most 120 characters.' never appears (the truncated name then hit 409 VIEW_NAME_TAKEN against the D4 view). D3 'Q', D4 (120), D8 Arabic, D9 (RLM kept), D10 emoji saved exactly as typed. D6 stored trimmed ('QA CV trim'). D7 'qa cv NAME' refused as a duplicate of 'QA CV name' (409, names are case-insensitive). D14 zero-width space and U+0007 kept as typed. D11 '' shown as literal text in the tab, picker, Manage page and delete dialog; no element, no script ran.

scenarios.title: A user cannot save two views with the same name in a module
scenarios.observed: OWNER already owns 'QA CV dup'. New custom view 'QA CV dup' -> Save refused, 409 VIEW_NAME_TAKEN, message 'You already have a view with this name.'; only one 'QA CV dup' (owner), row_version 1 unchanged.

scenarios.title: Two users may each own a view with the same name
scenarios.observed: As test user 2 (lower profile), New custom view 'QA CV dup' -> 201, toast 'Custom view "QA CV dup" created.', listed under test user 2's CREATED BY ME. OWNER's 'QA CV dup' unchanged.

scenarios.title: A list view and a queue with the same name follow one documented rule
scenarios.observed: Rule recorded: names are unique per owner and per kind. As OWNER the queue POST cannot reach the name check (409 WORKQUEUE_LIMIT - the owner already owns 15 queues). As test user 1: list 'QA CV k' -> 201 and queue 'QA CV k' -> 201; GET ?kind=list returns only the list, ?kind=queue only the queue.

scenarios.title: A criteria row with no value blocks save
scenarios.observed: Row Company | Contains | (empty), name 'QA CV incomplete' -> Save blocked with 'Complete this row (field, operator and value) or remove it.'; no POST sent; no 'QA CV incomplete' exists.

scenarios.title: Operators that take no value save without one
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1 on layout 'New Layout' (Standard has no checkbox field): rows Single Line Is empty, Created At Today, Use Wallet Number Is true. No value input appeared for any row; Save -> 201; stored conditions single_line is_empty null, created_at today null, use_wallet_number is_true null. Results: QA CV N01 (created today, wallet true, single line empty) only; the other 7 wallet-true records on the layout are excluded (not created today). Note: the Created Time field is labelled 'Created At' in the editor.

scenarios.title: A view holds at most 25 criteria rows in the UI and the API
scenarios.observed: Editor: 25 rows (Full Name Is not empty) added; 'Add criteria row' is disabled at 25; the 25-row view saved (201) with 25 stored conditions. API: POST with 26 conditions -> 422 INVALID_VIEW 'At most 25 criteria rows are allowed.'; no 'QA CV 26-rows' exists. Note: the disabled add button has no tooltip explaining the limit.

scenarios.title: The grid shows exactly the chosen columns in the chosen order
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. Editor (Standard layout): added Full Name, Lead Status, Company, Email, Phone, Lead Owner, Created At, Last Activity in that order ('Modified Time' is not offered; Last Activity = last_modified_at). Saved (201); stored columns in exactly that order. Grid after selecting the view: Full Name, Lead Status, Company, Email, Phone, Lead Owner, Created At, Last Activity - order correct - but two unchosen columns, Tags and Source, are appended.

scenarios.title: A view with no columns uses each person's usual columns
scenarios.observed: Editor shows 'No columns chosen: everyone sees their usual columns.'; 'QA CV no-columns' saved (201). Its grid shows the owner's usual columns (list-preferences visibleKeys: Full Name, Phone, Lead Status, Lead Owner, Created At, Last Activity) plus Tags and Source.

scenarios.title: More than 10 columns shows a tip, 30 are allowed and 31 are refused
scenarios.observed: Editor (FieldPermissions layout): no tip at 10 columns; at 11 'Tip: more than 10 columns makes the table hard to read.'. API: a 30-column view saves (201); PATCH with 31 columns -> 422 INVALID_VIEW 'A view may show at most 30 columns.'; GET still shows 30. Note: the 30-column save from the editor itself was interrupted by an owner-session revocation, so the 30-column save was confirmed through the API.

scenarios.title: Sort and page size are applied and out-of-range page sizes are refused
scenarios.observed: Works: 'QA CV sort-page' sorted Created At descending (header 'Created At ↓') with page size 10; PATCH page_size 9 and 201 -> 422 'Page size must be a whole number between 10 and 200.', stored value unchanged. FAIL: the editor offers only Each person's usual page size / 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 - 200 cannot be chosen although the server accepts it (PATCH 200 -> 200). With 200 stored, the editor shows 'Select…' and the grid shows 1–101 of 101 rows while its Rows per page control reads 10.

scenarios.title: A view applies only to the layout it was created on
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. Editor on Standard shows 'Applies to the "Standard" layout — its fields and its records.'; 'QA CV layout' saved with layout Standard. Views API lists it for layout Standard, not for New Layout. Picker on New Layout: 'No views match.'; back on Standard it is listed under CREATED BY ME and returns 101 records. Observation: GET records?view_id=<it>&layout_id=<New Layout> is not refused (returns 14 records), but the UI never makes that call.

scenarios.title: Sharing with selected users requires at least one user
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1 (Admin; owner sessions were being revoked by another sign-in). 'QA CV no-users', Share with = Selected users, no user picked, Save -> blocked with 'Choose at least one user, or share with everyone instead.'; no view created. API: POST visibility 'selected' with shared_user_ids [] -> 422 INVALID_VIEW 'Select at least one user to share this view with, or choose a different visibility.'

scenarios.title: Changing a shared view's criteria changes the recipient's results
scenarios.observed: ALT1 created 'QA CV shared15' (Full Name starts with 'QA CV L' + Lead Status equals 'No Answer' = status of L01), shared with test user 2 only. Test user 2's grid: L01, L15. ALT1 changed the criterion to 'Busy' (status of L02) -> 200. Test user 2 reloads the view: L02, L13, L14 (3 records) - matches the new criterion. Note: the deep-linked grid can take more than 8 s to load (see L08).

scenarios.title: A new view starts with the filters applied on the list
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. Filter sidebar: Lead Status, operator Equals, Busy ticked, Apply Filter -> 18 records (URL f=[{fieldKey:lead_status, operator:equals, value:Busy}]). New custom view shows 'The criteria start with the filters applied on the records page.' with the row 'Leads | Lead Status | Equals | Busy'. Saved 'QA CV from-filter-3': stored criteria lead_status equals Busy; the view returns the same 18 records. Observation: after saving, the list filter stays in the URL (&f=…) on top of the new view.

scenarios.title: Cancelling the editor creates nothing
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. Filled name 'QA CV discard', a criteria row; Cancel -> back to Leads, no POST; repeated with the top Back control -> back to Leads, no POST. List count unchanged; no 'QA CV discard' exists. (No 'discard changes?' prompt - not required.)

scenarios.title: A save over a newer version is refused, not silently overwritten
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. 'QA CV conflict' opened in the editor in two browser tabs. Tab 1 renamed to 'QA CV conflict-1' and saved (PATCH 200). Tab 2 changed the criteria value and saved -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; tab 2 shows 'Someone else saved this view after you opened it. Reload to get the latest version — your unsaved changes will be lost.' with Reload; after Reload the name is 'QA CV conflict-1'. Final view: name QA CV conflict-1, criteria value unchanged (tab 2's change not saved), row_version 2.

scenarios.title: Saving twice in quick succession creates one view only
scenarios.observed: UI (ALT1): double-click Save on 'QA CV double' sent one POST (201); one view exists - the Save button now guards against the second click. API (OWNER): two parallel POSTs 'QA CV double-api' -> 201 and 409 VIEW_NAME_TAKEN; one view exists.

scenarios.title: A PATCH with only a name keeps the other settings
scenarios.observed: 'QA CV partial' with 2 criteria rows, 8 columns, sort created_at asc, page size 50. PATCH {name:'QA CV partial-2', row_version} -> 200. Changed fields: only name, row_version and last_modified_at; settings, visibility and shared_user_ids identical.

scenarios.title: Read-only view keys cannot be changed through the API
scenarios.observed: PATCH is_system:true / owner_user_id:<test user 2> / category:public_views + can_edit:false / row_version:999 -> each 200 with the key ignored: is_system false, owner unchanged, category created_by_me, can_edit true; row_version only advanced +1 per save (1 -> 5). A PATCH with expected_row_version 1 -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT 'The view changed since you loaded it (current version 5).'

scenarios.title: Wrong value types in a create request are rejected cleanly
scenarios.observed: name 12345 / ['QA CV arr'] / {x:1} -> 400; name null -> 422; columns 'name' / {a:1} -> 422; criteria 'status=1' / [] / 7 -> 422; page_size '25' / [25] / {n:25} -> 422; no 500, list count unchanged. columns:null and page_size:null -> 201 (valid 'not set' values per the contract; deleted again).

scenarios.title: Saving after the token expires never loses work silently
scenarios.observed: Run as test user 1. Editor filled ('QA CV expiry', Full Name Is not empty, columns) at 09:13:27 and left open; the app refreshed the token in the background (POST /iam/auth/refresh 200 at 09:17:26). Save at 09:19:07 -> 201 at 09:19:18 (11 s); stored 1 condition; name still filled before save. No data lost. Observation: the save took 11 s with the editor still showing.

scenarios.title: Creating, editing, sharing, cloning and deleting a view are audit-logged
scenarios.observed: As ALT1: created 'QA CV audit', edited its criteria, shared it with Everyone, cloned it, deleted the clone. Audit Log (Settings > Security > Audit Log, API /audit/events) has 5 entries, each with actor 'Mahmoud Mohamed' (ALT1) and time: 10:13:02 created 'QA CV audit', 10:13:02 updated, 10:13:03 updated (sharing), 10:13:03 created 'Copy of QA CV audit' (clone), 10:13:03 deleted 'Copy of QA CV audit' (app metadata-engine, entity module_view). Note: the sharing change and the clone are logged as generic updated / created entries.

scenarios.title: Each field type offers exactly the operators listed in spec §2.3, with none missing and none extra
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1. Editor operator lists: Text (Company) = Contains, Does not contain, Equals, Not equal to, Starts with, Ends with, Is empty, Is not empty. Number/Currency/Amount = Equals, Not equal to, Greater than, Less than, ≥, ≤, Is empty, Is not empty (no between). Date = Is, Is before, Is after, Is between, Is not between, Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow, This/Last/Next week, month, year, In the last/next N days, Age in days, Due in days, Before now, After now, Is empty, Is not empty. Date-time = the date set plus In the last/next N hours. Checkbox = Is true, Is false. Pick list / status / Source / Stage = Contains any of, Contains none of, Equals, Not equal to, Is empty, Is not empty. Multi-select and Tags = Contains any of, Contains all of, Contains none of, Is empty, Is not empty. Lookup = Equals, Not equal to, Is empty, Is not empty. Owner offers 'Current user'. The Filter panel offers the same operators (e.g. Lead Status). Notes: Approval Status (system pick list) has no Is empty / Is not empty; the Deals Closing Date field was not found by label in the editor.

scenarios.title: Text operators split records correctly for odd input, follow the module filter's case rule, and treat SQL-like input as a literal
scenarios.observed: Run as ALT1, 7 values x 6 operators saved on 'QA CV text-sweep'; in all 42 cases the grid (records?view_id) equals the module filter (records?filters=) and the stored value equals the typed value byte-for-byte. Rules: case-insensitive (D3 starts_with 'Q' -> L01, L02, L04, L05; D7 equals 'QA CV ACME' -> L01, L02); leading/trailing spaces trimmed at match time but stored as typed (D6 equals -> L01, L02); D8 contains Arabic -> L03; D10 ends_with emoji -> L04; D12 SQL-like value treated as a literal (equals/contains 0, not_equal_to/does_not_contain all); D14 zero-width space kept, contains -> L05 only. No 500.

scenarios.title: is_empty and is_not_empty classify null, blank and whitespace-only text the same way as the module filter
scenarios.observed: Comment: L01 null, L02 empty string, L03 whitespace only, L04 'Call back'. is_empty -> L01, L02, L05…L15 (null and empty string count as empty); is_not_empty -> L03, L04 (whitespace-only counts as not empty); exact complement; L04 never in is_empty; both equal the module filter.

scenarios.title: Number operators are exact at the 9999.99 / 10000 / 10000.01 boundary
scenarios.observed: Deals D01 0, D02 9999.99, D03 10000, D04 10000.01, D05 empty, D06 -1, D07 15000, D08 1000000000. equals 10000 -> D03; not_equal_to -> D01, D02, D04, D05, D06, D07, D08 (empty included, same as module filter); greater_than -> D04, D07, D08; less_than -> D01, D02, D06; ≥ -> D03, D04, D07, D08; ≤ -> D01, D02, D03, D06; equals 9999.99 -> D02; equals 10000.01 -> D04. All equal the module filter.

scenarios.title: Odd numeric input is normalised or rejected with a message and is never stored as 15
scenarios.observed: Editor (Amount box is input type=number): Arabic-Indic digits and 'abc' leave the box empty and Save is blocked with 'Complete this row (field, operator and value) or remove it.'; '-1' saves and returns D06. FAIL (API): POST with value '15,000', Arabic-Indic '15000', '1e9' and 'abc' -> all 201 Created, the raw string is stored and the view matches 0 records - 'abc' is not rejected (expected 400/422) and '15,000' / '1e9' are neither normalised (15000 / 1000000000) nor rejected.

scenarios.title: An empty number is distinguished from zero in view criteria
scenarios.observed: is_empty -> D05 only; is_not_empty -> D01 (0), D02, D03, D04, D06, D07, D08 - never D05; equals 0 -> D01 only. All equal the module filter.

scenarios.title: Date is/before/after/between/not between follow one stated bound rule, including same-day bounds
scenarios.observed: FieldPermissions seeds RA1 29 Sep (D-6), RA2 30 Sep (D-5), RA3 3 Oct (D-2), RA4 5 Oct (D), RA5 6 Oct (D+1); D = 5 Oct 2026 Cairo. is D -> RA4; is_before -> RA1, RA2, RA3; is_after -> RA5; is_between D-5..D -> RA2, RA3, RA4 (bounds inclusive); is_not_between -> RA1, RA5 (exact complement); is_between D..D -> RA4. All equal the module filter.

scenarios.title: today, yesterday and tomorrow resolve in the tenant timezone (Cairo), not UTC
scenarios.observed: Date Time Permission seeds: T01 4 Oct 23:50, T02 5 Oct 00:10, T03 5 Oct 23:50, T04 6 Oct 00:10 Cairo (stored UTC). At 13:37 Cairo on 5 Oct: today -> T03, T04 (expected T02, T03); yesterday -> T01, T02 (expected T01); tomorrow -> none (expected T04). The grid shows T04 as '06/10/2026 12:10 AM' inside the Today view. The relative operators use the UTC date, not the Cairo date. Grid and module filter agree. (The case's 23:50 / 00:10 run times were not needed: the UTC-vs-Cairo split shows at any time.)

scenarios.title: this/last/next week, month and year return records inside the correct calendar boundaries
scenarios.observed: D = Mon 5 Oct 2026. Seeds W01 4 Oct, W02 5 Oct, W03 11 Oct, W04 12 Oct, W05 30 Sep, W06 1 Oct, W07 1 Nov, W08 31 Dec 2025, W09 1 Jan 2026, W10 1 Jan 2027. this_week -> W02, W03; last_week -> W01, W05, W06; next_week -> W04; this_month -> W01, W02, W03, W04, W06; last_month -> W05; next_month -> W07; this_year -> all 2026 seeds; last_year -> W08; next_year -> W10. Week starts on Monday. All equal the module filter.

scenarios.title: last_n_days, next_n_days, age_in_days and due_in_days accept 0/1–3650 and reject other values
scenarios.observed: API (24 POSTs, Date Permission): last_n_days / next_n_days accept 1 and 3650, reject 0, 3651, -1, 1.5 (lower bound 1); age_in_days / due_in_days accept 0, 1, 3650, reject 3651, -1, 1.5 (lower bound 0). scenarios.title: The picker, view editor, pattern editor and Kanban card move work with the keyboard alone
scenarios.observed: Keyboard only: focus 'Custom views', Enter -> focus moves to 'Search views'; typing filters; ArrowDown does NOT move into the list (focus stays in the search box); Tab reaches 'QA CV count' and Enter opens it. Editor: name typed, 'Filter by criteria' toggled with Space, 'Add criteria row' with Enter adds a row but focus is lost to the page body. 'Edit Pattern' opens with focus in the pattern box. Kanban card move by keyboard works (I13). FAIL: focus lost after 'Add criteria row'; no arrow-key navigation in the picker menu (reproduced from 4 Oct).

scenarios.title: View and Kanban controls expose meaningful accessible names
scenarios.observed: Names present: Leads picker 'Custom views', Deals 'Choose a Kanban view', 'Collapse all columns'; 0 unnamed buttons; no 'Load more' (no column over 100). FAIL: (1) every card checkbox carries its column's select-all name ('Select all loaded records in qualification' ×35, negotiation ×10 …); (2) every column button is just 'Collapse column', without the column name; (3) the drag live region reads the record UUID ('77828678-… is over needs_analysis.') instead of the record name. (Reproduced from 4 Oct.)

scenarios.title: At 390 px wide the picker and editor are usable with no horizontal page scroll
scenarios.observed: Viewport 390x844 (dropdown picker layout): document scrollWidth 390 (no horizontal page scroll); picker button opens by tap and lists views; editor usable - 'QA CV mobile' with Full Name starts with 'QA CV L' saved (201), editor scrollWidth 390. FAIL: the 'Create Lead' / 'More create options' buttons are cut off at the right edge of the header (only 'Crea… Lea…' visible). The 4 Oct tabs-layout break (0 px wide tab list) was not re-checked because this account is in dropdown layout.

scenarios.title: Core picker, create-view and Kanban flows behave the same in Edge, Chrome and Firefox
scenarios.observed: Same flow per browser (fresh sign-in each): picker search + switch to 'QA CV count'; create 'QA CV chrome/edge/firefox' (Full Name starts with 'QA CV L0') -> 201, 9 rows; Kanban 'QA CV kb-status' QA CV L01 No Answer -> Busy -> No Answer (PATCH 200 ×2, final No Answer). Chrome 131.0.6778.205 and Edge 154.0.4258.53: identical, only the unrelated 403 on /telephony/status in the console. Firefox 153.0 (Playwright build): identical results but a React '[ErrorBoundary] … Lazy@unknown' console error (reproduced from 4 Oct). Sign-out step skipped (a new sign-in revokes the previous session anyway). Note: the staging bundle changed during the run (index-Bzy9m5yg.js).

scenarios.title: A list view's first page loads within 1.5 s at p95 on Leads and Deals
scenarios.observed: 20 reloads each, navigation -> first row with content (Chromium, cache on, another operator active on the tenant). All Leads (128 records): p95 9125 ms, median 4122, min 2851, max 10116. All Deals (50 records): p95 3300 ms, median 2585, min 1945, max 3696. Target p95 <= 1.5 s missed on both (4 Oct: Leads p95 6826, Deals 3885).

scenarios.title: Kanban column headers and first cards render within 2 s at p95
scenarios.observed: Deals Kanban 'QA CV deals-by-stage' (Stage, Amount; 12 columns), 20 reloads until all column headers with Amount totals and at least one card are shown: p95 5100 ms, median 2290, min 1261, max 26045. Target 2 s p95 missed.

scenarios.title: With 15 pinned and 50 other views, the picker opens in under 500 ms and search stays responsive
scenarios.observed: 65 'QA CV perf-NN' views created via API, perf-01…15 pinned (15 pinned; 173 Leads list views in total). Picker open (click -> search box + list stable 2 frames), 10 times: median 110 ms, max 133 ms (< 500 ms). Search 'perf-4' -> only perf-40…49 immediately; 'zzz' -> 'No views match.' immediately. All 15 unpinned afterwards.

defects.title: Date-time 'today/yesterday/tomorrow' criteria use the UTC day instead of the tenant timezone (Cairo)
A user without the review permission can filter by review_status through the views API (condition accepted and applied), exposing review data
A criterion on a field hidden from the viewer exposes its value in the view editor and the view API
?view= with a deleted or foreign view ID falls back to the last-used view instead of All Leads
List preferences changed in two browser tabs: the later write silently overwrites the earlier one (lost update, no version conflict)
View API accepts non-numeric Amount values ('abc', '15,000', '1e9') and stores them as raw strings that match nothing
Lookup criteria in the view editor take free text only (no record picker); a typed record name is saved literally and matches nothing
View API accepts an operator that does not fit the field type (Amount 'contains' -> 201)
Arabic UI: the criteria pattern '(1 or 2) and (3 or 4)' is displayed as '( and (3 or 4) (or 2 1) )'
'Last Activity' in view criteria is the record's modified time; adding a note does not update it
After sign-out/sign-in Leads does not reopen the working view the user had open
Deleted criteria field: no banner on the view's list page (only in the editor, by API name) while the view keeps filtering on the deleted field
Manage Columns on a view with chosen columns offers no hidden/available fields, so a column (e.g. Comment) cannot be added
Manage Columns cannot add a column to a view (so a new column cannot be saved to the view)
Row selection is kept when switching to another view (bar still '3 selected')
Clone in the picker row menu (dropdown layout) does nothing
The 15-pinned-views limit is not enforced (16th pin accepted in UI and API)
Records whose value is beyond the 75-column cap vanish from the Kanban board; board-summary says truncated=false
A record holding a removed pick-list value is shown in an unmarked extra column - no 'no longer an option' flag
Deals Kanban by Stage has no pipeline picker, ignores the pipeline's stages and shows no stage probability
Dropping a deal on Closed Won/Lost opens no closing dialog - the move just fails with 'Closing Date is required'
Kanban move from a stale board overwrites a newer change with no conflict check
View name validation messages are never shown: empty/space-only names just disable Save, and a 121-character name is silently cut to 120
A view's grid shows two columns that were not chosen (Tags and Source are always appended)
Page size 200 is accepted by the server but cannot be chosen in the editor; with 200 stored the editor shows 'Select…' and the grid's Rows per page reads 10
A pick list value removed from the field is not shown in the view editor (blank 'Value', no warning), although the view still filters on it
An unbracketed criteria pattern is stored and redisplayed as typed instead of in its fully bracketed form
Upper-case 'AND' pattern is accepted by the editor and the API (case expects it to be rejected)
Module with no related modules: the editor still shows an empty related block and an enabled 'Add condition'
List preferences accept more than 50 column overrides (51 stored); no oldest-dropped or 4xx rule
Toolbar sort label shows API names ('Sort: amount desc') instead of the field label and direction
Rows per page offers 10/25/50/100 only - 200 is missing
Kanban view form: an over-long name gets only 'The view is not valid.' - the 120-character limit is not shown or enforced in the field
Kanban chooser does not label other users' views with 'Shared by <name>'
Split view criteria: the 'Add criteria row' button silently disables at 10 rows - no limit message
Arabic UI: 'records' in the record count and the sort label's field/direction are not translated
Arabic: header layout picker accessible name stays 'Layout'; 'records' untranslated
Keyboard: focus drops to <body> after 'Add criteria row'; picker list has no arrow-key navigation
Kanban a11y names: card checkboxes reuse the column select-all name, column buttons lack the column name, drag announcements read UUIDs
At 390 px the 'Create Lead' button is cut off at the right edge
Firefox: React ErrorBoundary console error from a lazy-loaded component during the view/Kanban flow
List first page p95 far above 1.5 s (Leads 9.1 s, Deals 3.3 s)
Kanban headers + first cards p95 5.1 s (target 2 s)
